TODAY’S LETTERA

Tap Open checkout to welcome a customer.

Little steps, lovely learning.
For grown-ups · letters, voice & classroom settings

Customers bring 2–5 items. Each item travels to the scanner, where the cashier introduces its name and letter. Tap the matching letter to scan and bag it. After eight items, the next stage unlocks. The alphabet collection has five objects per letter; X includes specialist vocabulary such as x-ray fish and xerus.

Changing the lesson starts a fresh customer.
